about.title: About Co-Lead Organization
about.description: An independent, non-profit, and civil society organization committed to developing leadership skills, fostering entrepreneurship, and promoting collaboration.
about.missionDescription: Building bridges between leaders and organizations, raising knowledge and skills, developing current and future leaders, and encouraging innovation and positive change in society.
about.visionDescription: Creating a society without discrimination based on gender, religion, and ethnicity that supports the public good and sustainable development.
about.coreValuesDescription: Empowerment, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and sustainability guide everything we do to create lasting positive impact.
about.approachDescription1: This New Year is especially meaningful as it marks the beginning of our journey as a newly established Co-Lead Organization. Today, we celebrate not only the start of a new year, but also a new partnership built on shared vision, collaboration, and leadership. This moment represents unity, commitment, and the promise of working together toward meaningful impact. As we step forward, we do so with enthusiasm, mutual respect, and confidence in what we can achieve together. Here's to fresh beginnings, strong collaboration, and a successful year ahead. Wishing everyone a joyful, productive, and inspiring New Year! 🎊

item1.title: A Beginning for Real Estate Seminar
item1.description: Today, Thursday 25/12/2025, Collide organized a seminar entitled A Beginning for Real Estate.
item1.fullContent:
Today, Thursday 25/12/2025, Collide organized a seminar entitled A Beginning for Real Estate.

At the beginning of the seminar, the head of the organization, Ms Hawzhin, spoke about the introduction, goals and work of the organization.

Then, the seminar was presented by the trainer and consultant in the field of real estate Mr. (Barzan Saber), to introduce young people to the field of real estate and working in the field of real estate.

In which the methods of working in the field of real estate, how to start working in real estate and the characteristics of real estate employees, and several other topics, were presented to the participants, and provided an open discussion and questions were presented by the participants.

item2.title: Training Seminar on How to Write a Professional CV
item2.description: We held a training seminar in collaboration with Qaladzeh Non-Governmental Institute of Science – Computer Department on how to write a professional CV for job applications.
item2.fullContent:
We held a training seminar in collaboration with Qaladzeh Non-Governmental Institute of Science – Computer Department

on ✍️ How to Write a Professional CV for Job Applications

presented by Trainer Hawzhin 🌱

During the seminar, participants learned about:

✔️ The fundamentals of writing a successful CV

✔️ Common mistakes in CV preparation

✔️ How to present skills and experience in a professional way

✔️ Building confidence to enter the job market

Together, we take one step closer to a better professional future

item3.title: Welcoming Project Managers from People's Organization for Development
item3.description: Co-Lead Organization welcomed the project managers of the People's Organization for Development and its members.
item3.fullContent: Co-Lead Organization welcomed the project managers of the People's Organization for Development and its members. During the visit, the plans and projects of the People's Organization for Development in the field of peace and mine clearance were presented at the Raperin administration, and discussions were held on joint and collaborative work in the future.

item4.title: Partnership with Local Organizations Strengthens Community Impact
item4.description: We are proud to announce new partnerships that will expand our reach and enhance our ability to serve more communities across the region.
item4.fullContent:
We are proud to announce new partnerships that will expand our reach and enhance our ability to serve more communities across the region. These collaborations will bring together resources and expertise to create greater positive change.

Our new partners include local businesses, international organizations, educational institutions, and government agencies. These partnerships will enable us to scale our programs, reach more beneficiaries, and leverage diverse expertise and resources.

Together, we will work on joint initiatives focusing on leadership development, entrepreneurship support, environmental sustainability, and community empowerment. We believe that collaboration is key to creating lasting impact, and we are excited about the opportunities these partnerships will bring to our communities. These strategic alliances will help us achieve our mission of building leaders for a sustainable future.
